title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Everyone Gets Got
California State Prison, Corcoran is a turbulent sea of politics: from old school prison gangs to disruptive street gangs, it's a dangerous mix for staff and inmates; known gang members are sent to security housing units to control their activity.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Love and Hate
Prison is a lonely place for any inmate; relationships that existed on the outside become strained and the ones that blossom within the prison walls are often dangerous; or they can be simply a one-sided obsession, leading to nothing but trouble.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Prison Politics
Violence often seems inevitable in prison; whether it stems from racial tension, or a dispute between cellmates, it's the job of Corcoran's officers to prevent attacks; in doing so, however, they put their own lives on the line.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Do Not Pass Go
The communities in Fairfax County, Virginia, have become some of the wealthiest and fastest growing in the nation, due in part to low crime rates, and, as one deputy says, taking care of the "little things" so "you don't have the big things.".

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — You Wanna Work Where?
Burnout is a constant problem and unexcused absences create staff shortages at Alabama's Holman Correctional Facility; that means that designated jobs, like cell searches, which each shift has a requirement to perform, don't always get done.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E2 — Counterfeit Goods
Carl Quintanilla investigates the counterfeit goods industry, which brings in billions every year.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E4 — Stolen Goods
Criminal networks of thieves break into everything and cash in on a fortune online, at flea markets and on the shelves of stores.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E5 — Deadly Prescriptions
Rogue pharmacies and strong prescription medicine in the wrong hands cause tragic outcomes; the problem of prescription-drug abuse.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Getting Schooled
One inmate learns addiction and motherhood do not make a good mix; two other inmates are left wondering which of them is the father of her child; when a feud from the streets boils over in the jail, deputies are forced to respond.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Old School, New School
Gang violence breaks out when a long-simmering feud boils over; caught in the middle of the conflict is a young inmate, and jail staff responds with an all-out search for weapons.
